name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Carver does not go with Chemistry if and only if Yearbook goes with Ames.
Carver goes with exactly one of French, Greenhouse, or Chess.
Library goes with exactly two of Carver, Chemistry, and Robotics.
Either Greenhouse goes with Chemistry or Music goes with Library.
Between Greenhouse and Robotics, one goes with Carver and the other with Dunn.

hints.text: Suppose Ames went with Greenhouse — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Ames goes with Greenhouse.
Greenhouse goes with Ames, so Carver can't go with Greenhouse.
Greenhouse goes with Ames, so Dunn can't go with Greenhouse.
…but now the clue “Between Greenhouse and Robotics, one goes with Carver and the other with Dunn” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Ames does not go with Greenhouse.

hints.text: Suppose Chemistry went with Library — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Chemistry goes with Library.
Chemistry goes with Library, so it can't also go with Greenhouse.
Library goes with Chemistry, so Music can't go with Library.
…but now the clue “Either Greenhouse goes with Chemistry or Music goes with Library” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Chemistry does not go with Library.
